children.design_delta_summary: 1) Add per-plane scoped conformance claim cards with an authoritative boundary identity and explicit implemented/provisional/blocked/local-only fields; 2) require each durable publication to cite exactly one audit-anchor CAS object plus a human-readable promise body; 3) require a minimal peer-local promise ledger with stable operation/effect keys and break-witness-on-ambiguous-restart for non-idempotent actions.

1) Add a layer-scoped conformance manifest that separates local implementation, live transport, audit publication, and device-effect claims while naming one authoritative protocol-boundary contract or contract-family identity. 2) Require every durable publication to cite a concrete CAS milestone object instead of a live channel or vague app state. 3) Add a minimal peer-local promise ledger that records who promised identity, availability, authorization, or physical effect, plus receipt and break-witness outcomes.
